mapper.sql: t.id, t.session_id, t.role, t.reasoning, t.content, t.status, t.add_time, t.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_ai_session_msg SET content = #{content}, reasoning = #{reasoning}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT MAX(t.id) FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t JOIN xxl_ai_session AS s ON t.session_id = s.id WHERE s.agent_id = #{agentId} AND s.visitor_id = #{visitorId}

SELECT t.id, t.session_id, t.role, t.reasoning, t.content, t.status, t.add_time, t.update_time FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t JOIN xxl_ai_session AS s ON t.session_id = s.id WHERE s.agent_id = #{agentId} AND s.visitor_id = #{visitorId} AND t.id > #{afterId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t WHERE t.add_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date` ASC

SELECT IFNULL(a.name, CAST(c.agent_id AS CHAR)) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `value` FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t JOIN xxl_ai_session AS c ON t.session_id = c.id LEFT JOIN xxl_ai_agent AS a ON a.id = c.agent_id WHERE t.add_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY a.id, a.name, c.agent_id ORDER BY `value` DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t INNER JOIN xxl_ai_session AS c ON t.session_id = c.id INNER JOIN xxl_ai_agent AS a ON a.id = c.agent_id WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.add_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date` ASC

SELECT IFNULL(a.name, CAST(c.agent_id AS CHAR)) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `value` FROM xxl_ai_session_msg AS t INNER JOIN xxl_ai_session AS c ON t.session_id = c.id INNER JOIN xxl_ai_agent AS a ON a.id = c.agent_id WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.add_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY a.id, a.name, c.agent_id ORDER BY `value` DESC
